recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: a megacity learning to keep its light from leaking into the dark
institutions migrating toward unfamiliar operating shores
cameras memorizing a million faces that lead nowhere
a new intelligence held at the safety checkpoint
clear autumn night over san francisco, eleven degrees
eviction stories rippling through the housing map

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Patch a leaking city power grid before an autumn blackout spreads — each sealed node relights a block in the dark.
composer-2.5-fast.mechanic: tap to seal junctions, drag to reroute flowing energy
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: watch dim neighborhoods flare back to life one node at a time in under a minute
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: new leaks spawn faster as more blocks reconnect to the main grid

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Gate-check a conveyor of agent prompts before sunrise ship — swipe safe ones through, divert suspicious patterns to a review lane.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: clear one shipping batch before the dawn timer hits zero
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: prompts grow longer and sneakier; decoy safe-looking ones appear mid-conveyor
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: paper cutout terminal windows with amber sunrise bleed

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: A rotating gallery of blurred faces — tap when the same one returns, but let false positives drift past as scan noise thickens.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: build a streak of correct matches without triggering a false alarm
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: faces rotate faster and decoy duplicates multiply each wave
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: washed-out surveillance monochrome with autumn amber accents

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Hold your thumb on a drifting constellation path over a fog city — release to let agent stars connect; breaking flow dims the whole sky.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: chain five clean star connections to complete one orbit
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: wind gusts knock the path off course and shrink the safe hold window
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: watercolor night sky over san francisco fog
